europe_now.title: Russian Strikes Depower Hundreds of Thousands in Ukraine
europe_now.summary: Recent Russian military strikes targeting energy infrastructure in eastern Ukraine have left hundreds of thousands of residents without power. Officials and reporting confirm widespread outages affecting regional populations as winter approaches.

sources.headline: Ukraine: Russian strikes leave hundreds of thousands without power
Russian strikes leave 600,000 in the dark in eastern Ukraine

europe_now.title: Terrorism Investigation Launched After Fatal Krakow Shootings
europe_now.summary: Polish prosecutors have initiated a terrorism investigation following a mass shooting incident in Krakow that resulted in multiple fatalities. The country remains in shock as authorities continue security and criminal inquiries into the attack.

sources.headline: Poland in shock after 6 killed in Krakow far-right shooting
Poland launches terrorism probe into mass shooting in Krakow

top_stories.title: European Representation in Upcoming Ukraine Peace Talks
top_stories.summary: European officials will participate in upcoming peace negotiations regarding the conflict in Ukraine. The discussions are scheduled to take place in Abu Dhabi with mediation from the United States.

sources.headline: Europe will take part in US-mediated Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi, French FM says
Europe will be represented in Abu Dhabi talks on Ukraine, French foreign minister says

top_stories.title: Wirecard Fugitive Communications Revealed
top_stories.summary: Messages from fugitive Wirecard executive Jan Marsalek have surfaced regarding past political events in Austria. The communications allegedly involve discussions held with a Russian intelligence contact.
